data.exact_reserve_text: It is disappointing to record a loss for the year, which is driven primarily by reserves strengthening on discontinued business plus reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic.

named_events.loss_description: The syndicate has recorded a net loss reserve of GBP 7.5m

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.864m. Using the gross claims development triangle, prior-year (2018 and earlier) reserves were re-estimated adversely by approximately GBP 11.431m (a strengthening equal to ~28.7% of opening gross reserves). Management attribute the reserve strengthening principally to adverse development on discontinued business and additional provisions for potential COVID-19 claims; COVID-19-related net loss reserves of GBP 7.5m are recorded (net basis) primarily affecting professional lines.
raw_causal_phrases: reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic
There is uncertainty in all loss reserves but, in the case of COVID-19, that uncertainty is extended by the nature of the loss event and the fact that the loss is ongoing.
The syndicate has recorded a net loss reserve of GBP 7.5m
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not stated as a single gross 'movement in prior years' figure in the notes; the gross PYD was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred row) as a fallback. The triangle is presented in GBP 000; the extracted PYD (11.431m) is calculated for underwriting years <=2018 only (excluding 2019 and 2020 as per instructions). The COVID-19 reserve cited (GBP 7.5m) is a net figure (after reinsurance) and not a gross PYD amount. No explicit gross prior-year movement note broken down by insurance liabilities was found. Line-of-business allocations of the gross PYD are not provided in the report; LOB-level amounts in lob_movements are therefore largely unquantified or net-only where indicated.
